turnos.t: Does a tiny one-person café really have business functions?
Yes, all four. Human resources is about people: hiring and training baristas. Finance and accounts is about money: can we pay for the espresso machine?

Marketing is about customers: who buys and why, with a loyalty card or Instagram. Operations is about production: brewing speed and enough beans in stock. They all depend on each other, which is why the course has one unit for each.
